items.text: On one acute adult psychiatric unit, over nine months, what proportions of eligible admissions are screened by the named nurse, screen positive, accept a two-session brief intervention, receive both sessions as intended, and are reached by phone three months after discharge?
items.population: Adults admitted to the unit who are well enough to be screened before discharge
items.intervention: Screening by the named nurse and a two-session brief motivational intervention
items.outcome: Screening, uptake, delivery, fidelity and three-month follow-up proportions against pre-stated progression criteria
items.time: January to September 2027 recruitment, three-month follow-up

finer: Feasible within approved nurse time; interesting to the ward and the community alcohol team; novel for inpatient psychiatry; ethical with capacity safeguards; relevant because it decides whether a larger evaluation is worth doing.
summary: One feasibility question with five proportions.
